description: Use this when someone asks to add a new pet owner to their vet clinic. Returns the owner's id, name, clinic and language; the phone and email given are saved but never returned. Not for adding an animal.

clinicId.description: Id of the clinic, from list_clinics. Leave it out when the user has one clinic.

language.description: Language for their messages, as a code such as en, it or pt-BR. Defaults to the clinic language.

phone.description: Mobile number, with the country code when known.

requestId.description: A unique id you choose for this owner, such as a UUID. Calling again with the same requestId returns the first owner rather than adding a second one.

name: create_client
title: Add a pet owner
